selectionHelp: Select up to 10 devices. All compatible channels are imported together; rename or disable them afterward in Hardware.
title: Measurements and Home Assistant
configureHelp: Configure the Home Assistant URL and private token on the server.
importHelp: Import complete devices with all compatible channels. Existing hardware and channels are reused. Rename or disable channels in Hardware.
manualHelp: You can also add hardware without connecting it to a smart-home service.
unavailable: Currently unavailable; readings will start when a numeric value is available.
noLinks: No Home Assistant entities imported yet.
noSensor: Choose a sensor to view its readings. A manually added sensor may have no data yet.
rangeHelp: Shows the last 24 hours by default. Choose up to 31 days. Times use your local time zone.
chartHelp: Shows the {count} readings on this page, oldest first. Exact values are in the table.
noReadings: No readings in this time range.

outcomes.duplicate: This reading was already recorded; no duplicate was added.
outcomes.queued: Collection scheduled. Refresh the list after processing.

errors.notConfigured: Home Assistant configuration is missing or invalid.
errors.accessDenied: Home Assistant rejected this token or its permissions.
errors.entityMissing: A selected entity is no longer available in Home Assistant.
errors.providerUnavailable: Home Assistant could not be reached or returned an invalid response.
errors.responseTooLarge: The provider response exceeds the supported size.
errors.typeConflict: A measurement type conflicts with the imported unit.
errors.conflict: This import link changed. The current list has been reloaded.
errors.disabled: Collection is paused, the sensor is disabled, or its device is retired.
errors.instanceChanged: This link belongs to a different configured Home Assistant instance.
errors.invalidValue: The entity has no supported finite numeric value.
errors.unitMismatch: The reported unit does not match the sensor unit. No conversion was applied.
errors.invalidTime: The reported timestamp is invalid or too far in the future.
errors.sampleConflict: Another value is already recorded for this sensor and timestamp; history was preserved.
errors.deviceRetired: Restore the retired source device before importing more of its entities.
errors.sourceConflict: This channel already uses another source. Remove that source before importing this entity again.
errors.invalidQuality: Choose good, unknown, suspect or invalid quality.

validation.inputInvalid: Check the fields and select 1 to 10 distinct entities.
validation.rangeInvalid: Choose an ordered time range of at most 31 days.
validation.timeInvalid: Enter a valid date and time.

removeHelp: Remove this entity from the integration? Collection will stop. Hardware, channels and recorded measurements will be kept. The entity will remain unchanged in the connected service.

sync.title: Automatic synchronization
sync.help: Minute-level estimate; queue backlog and provider errors may delay completion. Configure the interval in Settings → Connections.
sync.events: Provider events enabled; periodic reconciliation retained.
